title: Mika hình thái 2 · bị đánh (sheet hurt mới)
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body and weapon always inside the frame with a margin, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth and tails always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: K2
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl swordswoman in black and gold plate armour with a red scarf and long red cape tails, wielding a big broad greatsword with a wide silver blade, already recoiling from a hard hit at the first frame, dazed with eyes shut, immediately begins recovering: no second jolt. She opens her eyes, steadies herself with a slight knee flex and returns smoothly to her guard stance of the last frame; hair, cape and tails swing with one diminishing overshoot. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding or hopping; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the weapon action; hair, cloth and tails follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid weapon, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added flames, aura or particles.
